services.name: Group Lessons
services.desc: One of the most important things you can teach your baby is to swim or to float in the up right position. We offer 2 different types of programs for our baby swim lessons. Kids are always attracted to water, so its very important that your child knows how to swim. We offer 3 different types of programs for our kids swim lessons. When your kids enter the age of going to school then they will meet lots of friends. With all there new friends they will have alot of invitations to birthday parties and swim parties are one of the more popular kid parties to throw. Get your child geared up for any swim party that they may want to attend so you aren't worried about them drowning. We offer 4
